meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计直观可扩展的接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在涉及接口设计时会按 REST 与 GraphQL 原则工作:输出资源命名、HTTP 方法语义、版本策略、分页与限流等建议,并指出常见设计陷阱。
howto.when: 当你设计新 API、评审 API 规范,或为团队制定 API 设计标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新 REST API 的资源和 URL 结构
say.note: 会给出名词化资源、HTTP 方法对应关系

say.text: 评审这份 API 规范,指出命名和状态码问题
say.note: 按最佳实践逐条列出问题与改法

say.text: 为团队定一套 API 版本策略,对比几种做法
say.note: 会对比 URL、Header、查询参数三种版本方式

howto.what_en: When APIs come up, Claude applies REST and GraphQL design principles: it suggests resource naming, HTTP method semantics, versioning, pagination and rate limiting, and flags common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a new API, review an API spec, or set team API design standards.

say_en.text: Design the resources and URL structure for a new REST API
say_en.note: Covers noun-based resources and HTTP methods

say_en.text: Review this API spec and flag naming and status code issues
say_en.note: Lists issues and fixes by best practice

say_en.text: Define an API versioning strategy, comparing the options
say_en.note: Compares URL, header and query param versioning
